notes: Read SKILL.md and references/sas-tokens.md, references/streaming.md in full. The skill is an SDK reference for @azure/storage-blob in TypeScript/JavaScript: client authentication, container/blob CRUD, SAS generation, streaming and block uploads.

The only command is the Installation block `npm install @azure/storage-blob @azure/identity` (official Microsoft packages) for the user's project; everything else is sample code the user's application would run against their own storage account with placeholder names and credentials from environment variables. No instruction for the agent itself to read, print or transmit secrets, call services, or delete data.

Samples include delete operations (containerClient.delete, blobClient.delete, a cleanup delete at streaming.md:401) and broad SAS permissions (account SAS 'rwdlacupi' at SKILL.md:359 and sas-tokens.md:159); these are user-code patterns, and sas-tokens.md:465-487 recommends least privilege, short expiry and user-delegation SAS. Some samples print full SAS URLs to the console (sas-tokens.md:405-457), which users should avoid in production logs.
